title: cotula pectinata subsp. villosa
intro: Cotula pectinata subsp. villosa, commonly known as Woolly cotula or Woolly false mayweed, is a plant species in the daisy family Asteraceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its purported health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties that may aid in wound healing, reduce fever, and alleviate symptoms of respiratory issues such as colds and bronchitis. The therapeutic actions of Cotula pectinata subsp. villosa include expectorant and mucolytic effects, which can help loosen and clear mucus from the respiratory tract. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
